environment.description: Kubernetes deployment with a standard nginx ingress controller (ingress-nginx v1.9.4) configured with TLS termination only (no client certificate verification). The service is exposed via NodePort with ingress path /api/v1/metadata. No network policies restrict access to the pod. The container runs as root with no seccomp profile. The Go binary is compiled with CGO_ENABLED=1.

config.ingress: ingress-nginx v1.9.4, TLS termination, no auth-tls annotations
